enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes. Falls asleep. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Continues sleeping.

Opens eyes. Stretches arms. Sits up on bed. Picks up phone from nightstand. Presses power button. Unlocks phone. Scrolls through notifications. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Throws off blanket. Stands up.

Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Washes hair with shampoo. Rinses hair. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator, takes out eggs, milk, butter, closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet, takes out bowl, pan, closes cabinet. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Adds milk, whisks eggs. Pours into pan. Cooks eggs, stirs. Turns off stove. Slides eggs onto plate. Places plate on table. Sits down. Eats eggs, drinks milk. Picks up plate, puts plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out shirt, pants, socks, shoes. Closes closet. Lays clothes on bed. Takes off pajamas. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to mirror. Brushes hair. Picks up bag. Opens bag. Places laptop inside. Closes bag. Picks up phone, keys. Opens door. Walks out.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives, steps onto bus. Pays fare. Finds seat, sits down. Checks phone, reads news. Bus stops, stands up. Walks to door, steps off bus. Walks to office building. Opens door, walks to elevator. Presses button, waits for elevator. Elevator arrives, steps in. Presses floor button. Elevator stops, steps out. Walks to office, opens door, enters.

Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Answers phone. Talks on phone. Writes notes. Attends meeting. Discusses program plans. Makes phone calls. Types on computer. Prints documents. Files papers. Stands up, walks to copier. Copies documents. Returns to desk. Continues working on computer.

Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Talks with colleague. Finishes eating. Clears tray. Walks outside. Walks around block. Returns to office.

Sits at desk. Reviews schedule. Makes phone calls. Sends emails. Meets with team. Discusses program logistics. Types reports. Prints materials. Organizes files. Attends conference call. Takes notes. Updates database. Stands up, stretches. Walks to printer. Retrieves documents. Returns to desk. Continues working.

Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives, steps onto bus. Pays fare. Finds seat, sits down. Checks phone. Reads news. Bus stops, stands up. Walks to door, steps off bus. Walks home. Opens door, enters.

Walks into kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator, takes out vegetables, chicken, closes refrigerator. Opens cabinet, takes out pot, closes cabinet. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds water to pot. Chops vegetables. Adds chicken to pot. Cooks soup. Stirs soup. Turns off stove. Ladles soup into bowl. Places bowl on table. Sits down. Eats soup. Drinks water. Picks up bowl, puts bowl in sink.

Walks into living room. Turns on light. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts phone down. Adjusts volume. Gets up. Goes to kitchen. Gets snack. Returns. Sits down. Continues watching TV.
Opens laptop. Turns on computer. Logs in. Opens browser. Checks social media. Watches videos. Types email. Reads news. Plays game. Closes browser. Shuts down computer. Closes laptop.

Picks up book. Reads book. Puts down book. Picks up phone. Plays game. Puts down phone. Picks up magazine. Flips pages. Reads article. Puts down magazine. Stands up. Stretches. Walks to kitchen. Gets water. Returns. Sits down. Listens to music. Turns off music.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Picks up floss. Flosses teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks out.
Walks into bedroom. Turns off light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes. Falls asleep.
